profile.name: Liu Liu
profile.title: Researcher
profile.bio: I am a researcher at Horizon Robotics, focusing on 3D Vision and Embodied AI. I contribute to our open-source Robot Lab ecosystem through project pages, code releases, and training stacks for embodied intelligence, with recent work spanning 3D reconstruction, generative world modeling, and robot policy transfer.

open_source.title: HoloAgent-0
open_source.description: A unified, agentic system for general-purpose robots, enabling multi-modal perception, mapping and localization, and autonomous mobility and manipulation. v0 release.

open_source.title: EmbodiedGen V2
open_source.description: A generative 3D world engine for embodied intelligence — V2 upgrade with enhanced generation quality and expanded capabilities. Project page, paper, and open-source code available.

news.content: SimWeaver and IGGT4D project pages and paper released.
NoDrift3R and TabletopGen accepted to ECCV 2026.
Three papers accepted to CVPR 2026: Uni3R (highlight), 3D-Fixer, and RoboTransfer.
EmbodiedGen and RoboTransfer project pages and repositories went live in the Robot Lab ecosystem.
